text: The area electives pool for the Marketing Minor Undergraduate Program (MKTG-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2024-2025 (202401) contains 32 courses; minimum 6 SU credits required; minimum 2 courses required. Courses: CS 412 Machine Learning, CS 445 Natural Language Processing, CS 455 Large Language Models: Theoretical Foundations and Practical Applications, DSA 301 Data Visualization, DSA 473 Time Series and Forecasting Models, ECON 370 Advanced Microeconomics, ECON 401 Applied Econometrics, ECON 435 Discrete Choice Methods, ECON 494 Spatial Data Science, IE 404 Digital Transformation, IE 405 Decision Analysis, IE 451 Data Analytics and Optimization, MGMT 301 Introduction to Sustainability, MGMT 402 Entrepreneurship, MGMT 404 Technology Management, MGMT 417 Strategy Execution, OPIM 401 Supply Chain Management, OPIM 402 Optimization Modeling in Business Analytics, OPIM 404 Business Process Analysis and Design, OPIM 408 Retail Operations and Analytics, OPIM 410 Decision Making Under Uncertainty, ORG 404 Creativity & Leading Innovations, PSY 305 Experimental Psychology, PSY 311 Emotion, PSY 312 Sensation / Perception, PSY 315 Memory, PSY 316 Attention, PSY 340 Social Psychology, PSY 341 Applied Social Psychology, PSY 361 Personality, PSY 443 Psychology of the Self, PSY 452 Cognitive Neuroscience. 2 courses must be taken from this pool. Extra core electives are also counted here. Depending on interest, students may follow a more quantitative track (e.g., Marketing Analytics, Optimization, Modeling, Data Science), a consumer/strategy-oriented track (e.g., Consumer Behavior, Brand Management, Psychology), or a strategy track (e.g., Marketing Strategy, Management, Innovation). Please refer to the “Suggested Tracks” section for the potential course pairings.
